answer: The only reservation a State may make to the Council of Europe Framework Convention on Artificial Intelligence is provided for in Article 33, paragraph 1. It permits a federal State to reserve the right to assume obligations under the Convention consistent with its fundamental principles governing the relationship between its central government and constituent states or other similar territorial entities. This means that the Convention shall apply to the central government of the federal State, while the application of its provisions may depend on the jurisdiction of constituent states that are not obliged to take legislative measures under the federation's constitutional system.
